sections.title: Mod files reference
sections.intro: Look up the manifest, the packed file format, table patches, test files, validator codes and the C API of a mod.
sections.about:
## About the mod files reference

These pages describe the files a mod is made of and the rules LumaLink and Nebula check them against. For an introduction, see [About mod files and layers](../concepts/mod-files-and-layers.md).

sections.title: Game data reference
sections.intro: Look up the game's classes, events, nerves and tables by name.
sections.about:
## About the game data reference

These pages list the names in the game that a mod can use. LumaLink checks every name your mod uses against the game description when it builds. For more information, see [About the game description](../concepts/the-game-description.md).
